name: agentscene-builder
description: Digital modeling Skill and CLI for LLM-powered Agents to find, compose, calculate and verify reusable 3D models.

interface.shortDescription: Build renderer-neutral digital models through Skill + CLI.
interface.longDescription: AgentSceneBuilder gives LLM-powered Agents an open model registry, CompositionSpec, deterministic spatial methods and JSON diagnostics through Skill and CLI without MCP or a long-running service. The browser tools support visual review of the same models.
defaultPrompt: Build a CompositionSpec model with AgentSceneBuilder.
Search the model library and reuse spatial methods.
Analyze paths, anchors, attachments, and bounds.
